draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.83, the 205th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 26th of 32 at WR. He went 228th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,032 receiving yards in 2022, 11th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.
